_meta.purpose: Locked set-completeness cases for DP-300 Source discovery v2.
_meta.protocol: Each case is a hand-read set of real documentation pages. Quotes were checked live against the page text after normal whitespace and punctuation normalization. Complete means the set together teaches the whole skill; incomplete means the set only teaches part of a multi-part skill.

cases.domain: Plan and implement data platform resources
cases.group: Plan and deploy Azure SQL solutions

pages.quote: SQL Server enabled by Azure Arc extends Azure services to SQL Server instances hosted outside of Azure:
It replicates data in near real-time from SQL Server hosted anywhere to Azure SQL Managed Instance, or from Azure SQL Managed Instance to SQL Server 2022 or later hosted anywhere.

cases.label: complete
cases.why: Together the two pages cover both hybrid patterns named in the locked positives: Arc-enabled SQL Server and Managed Instance link.

cases.text: Implement a migration between Azure SQL services
cases.domain: Plan and implement data platform resources
cases.group: Plan and implement a migration strategy

pages.quote: A BACPAC file can be stored in Azure Blob storage or in local storage in an on-premises location and later imported back into Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, or a SQL Server instance.
You can import the data from a BACPAC file stored in Azure Blob storage (standard storage only) or from local storage in an on-premises location.

cases.label: complete
cases.why: Export plus import together provide a full BACPAC-based migration path between Azure SQL services.

cases.text: Configure alerts and notifications on database tasks
cases.domain: Configure and manage automation of tasks
cases.group: Create and manage database tasks in Azure

pages.quote: Alerts can send you an email or call a webhook when some metric (for example, database size or CPU usage) reaches the threshold.

This article describes how to set notification options in SQL Server by using SQL Server Management Studio, Transact-SQL, or SQL Server Management Objects, so SQL Server Agent can send notifications to operators about jobs.
This topic describes how to assign Microsoft SQL Server Agent alerts to operators so they can receive notifications about jobs in SQL Server by using SQL Server Management Studio or Transact-SQL.

cases.label: complete
cases.why: The set covers Azure SQL alert creation plus SQL Server Agent job and alert notifications.
